dsh-perlica-ding 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

posts.en:
dsh-perlica-ding is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d85844e8ad214d894839.html
